name: notebook-slides
description: Plan and build NotebookLM-quality slide decks: outline, a theme designed from scratch for the content, per-page designs, then either one image per slide delivered as a PDF, or an editable PowerPoint (.pptx) built from native text, shapes and charts over text-free art.

interface.longDescription: Turns your chat, notes, and uploaded files into a slide deck at the design level of NotebookLM. It works in three checkpoints you approve: an outline with the content of every page, a master theme designed from scratch for your subject, and a detailed design of each page. Then it either renders every slide as a finished 16:9 image and combines them into one PDF, or builds an editable PowerPoint file from native text, shapes, charts and tables over text-free generated art.
capabilities: Design a custom theme per deck
defaultPrompt: Make a slide deck from these notes.
Turn the attached report into an editable 12-slide PowerPoint.
Make a 10-slide deck about octopus intelligence.
